text:
Situation: Acyclovir sodium supply is limited across Corvale sites. Corvale East has 39 days of supply on hand, Corvale General has 17 days, and Corvale Lakeside has 25 days. Current stock includes 502 units at East (38.5 days), 211.41 and 339.38 units at General (13.7 and 22 days), 256.22 units of valacyclovir hydrochloride at General (16.4 days), and 101 units at Lakeside (24.8 days).

Why (FDA record): The label for our acyclovir sodium product names Aurobindo Pharma Limited as the manufacturing plant. That facility was classified Official Action Indicated (OAI) on 2026-02-06. The same facility, operating as Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited, received a Warning Letter on 2024-08-15 and an OAI classification on 2024-02-02. A recall by AuroMedics Pharma LLC for particulate matter in acyclovir sodium injection was initiated on 2022-09-26 and completed. Acyclovir sodium is not listed on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: We have adequate short-term inventory but face regulatory risk at the named manufacturing site. Alternative suppliers are available and not on FDA's shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Eugia US LLC as primary alternative.
2. Buyer to qualify Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as secondary source.
3. Buyer to qualify Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. as tertiary source.
4. Buyer to qualify ProPharma Distribution as quaternary source.
5. Buyer to qualify Slate Run Pharmaceuticals, LLC as quinary source.
6. Pharmacy director to approve any new vendor agreements.
7. P&T committee to review therapeutic alternatives if supply cannot be maintained.

Not recommended: Switching to valacyclovir hydrochloride without clinician and committee review. Delaying procurement until stock falls below 14 days at any site.
